'Target weapon attack gets +2{p}. Your next weapon attack this turn gets +2{p}.'

No printed keywords, so nothing is left to the card DB.

Clause 1: ATTACK_REACTION + target.filter ATTACK_IS_WEAPON. The release note ('you can only play this if there is a weapon attack to target') is the targeting restriction, so it lives in target.filter - checked at play/declare time by play._legality_check against state.combat - not in ability-level conditions (checked at resolution). ATTACK_IS_WEAPON reads combat.from_weapon (condition_types.py:198-199); same role as ironsong_response_blue's target filter, which is the shipped precedent for 'Target <kind> attack' reactions. MODIFY_ATTACK has no target parameter - it acts on state.combat (effect_types.py:4059-4094), which in the reaction step IS the targeted weapon attack; it appends to combat.power_mods so the +2 survives later recalculations.

Clause 2: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK queues one-shot on the controller (effect_types.py:4511-4537) and is consumed by the first attack whose specs all pass - engine.py:1175-1236 compiles each filter spec against the incoming attack; ATTACK_IS_WEAPON ignores its card argument and reads combat.from_weapon, which is set for the attack being consumed. Scope defaults to TURN, matching 'this turn'.
